submittedIntro: Your possession claim has been submitted. We’ve sent you a confirmation email.
whatHappensNext: The claim will be sent to the defendants and they can respond.
The court will schedule a hearing where a judge will consider the claim and any response and make a decision. You should attend the hearing.
claimSubmitted.claimFormText: Your claim form will be ready a few minutes after your payment has gone through. You can view it with the documents you uploaded.
claimSubmitted.feedbackLink: What did you think of this service? (opens in new tab)
generalApplicationAndSupport: If you need to submit a general application as part of this claim, you must do it within 24 hours.
You can submit a general application by selecting ‘Ask the court to make an order (make a general application)’ on your case overview.
If you need support to use HMCTS services (opens in a new tab), either before or during a hearing, you must let us know as soon as possible.
